home.tagline: A two-phase learning engine that takes you from first exposure to genuine mastery — and keeps knowledge sharp long after.

phases.title: 5-Phase Mastery
phases.desc: Learning → Isolation → Integration → Confirmed → Spiral Review. No shortcuts, no forgetting.

confirmation.title: True Confirmation
confirmation.desc: Cards must prove themselves in context — mixed with everything you know — before counting as mastered.

tracking.title: Progress Tracking
tracking.desc: Visual dashboard shows accuracy, streaks, and mastery across every dataset

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.desc: Compete on speed, accuracy, and overall score against other learners

cta.title: Ready to Master What You Study?
cta.subtitle: Isolation builds it. Integration proves it. Spiral review locks it in.

rules.title: The 5 Phases of Mastery
rules.subtitle: Every card travels through five phases — from first encounter to confirmed, long-term knowledge — with automatic safety nets that prevent forgetting along the way.

learning.label: Learning
learning.title: Learning
learning.desc: Cards are introduced in small batches of 5 from your initial set of {{count}}. You practice each batch in isolation — weak cards reappear more often until the whole batch reaches 80% accuracy across at least 3 attempts with a 2-answer success streak.

isolationMastered.label: Isolation Mastered
isolationMastered.title: Isolation Mastered
isolationMastered.desc: A batch has proven itself in its own isolated context. These cards are ready to be tested in the real world — mixed with everything else you've learned. This is the bridge between practicing in a safe environment and true mastery.

integrationReview.label: Integration Review
integrationReview.title: Integration Review
integrationReview.desc: Cards enter the integration pool and are presented alongside all your previously mastered cards. Pattern-matching from a small batch no longer works here. Confirm mastery or the card cycles back to Learning for additional drilling.

integrationConfirmed.label: Integration Confirmed
integrationConfirmed.title: Integration Confirmed
integrationConfirmed.desc: You've proven you know this card in context. Confirmed cards enter maintenance mode — they still appear periodically to keep the knowledge fresh, but they no longer block your progress. Each stage unlocks {{increment}} new cards (up to {{max}} total).

spiralReview.label: Spiral Review
spiralReview.title: Spiral Review
spiralReview.desc: Every few integration cycles the system automatically identifies confirmed cards that have weakened — low accuracy, fading stability, or repeated stumbles. These are pulled into a focused spiral pass to restore confidence before they slip back to unknown. Nothing stays forgotten.

rules.spacedRepDesc: After Phase 4, confirmed cards are scheduled at increasing intervals — you only review what you're about to forget, never what you already know cold.
rules.why5Desc: Isolation builds confidence. Integration tests real understanding. Spiral review catches what fades. Together they produce retention that holds months later — not just until the next test.
